description: This is an HTML file that serves as the user interface for a database visualizer web application. It includes embedded CSS styles and JavaScript code to load databases, tables, and display table data interactively.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting current selections and UI elements.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles the user interaction to expand or collapse a database's table list.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data in an HTML table with capabilities for expanding long or object cells.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Returns HTML for data cell, handling null, object, or long string contents.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full data or truncate.

search-terms: AJAX API calls for database metadata
